ar.Add stock to sides and top-bottom: Add stock to sides and top-bottom
ar.Click a point on the work box, or type X: Click a point on the work box, or type X Y Z. Editing the numbers keeps your point.
ar.Select the bodies for this setup. The se: Select the bodies for this setup. The setup has no work area until those bodies are chosen.
ar.Select the bodies to machine. That selec: Select the bodies to machine. That selection is the work area; the WCS origin is relative to it.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.adaptive: Adaptive clears a 2D pocket with a steady tool load in light passes. Use it to rough out a pocket when the tool should not take full-width cuts.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.bore: Bore machines a round hole to size with a boring bar. Use it when a drilled hole needs a more accurate diameter or a better finish.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.chamfer: Chamfer cuts an angled edge along the outline of a 2D shape. Use it to break sharp edges or add a bevel to a machined part.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.circular: Circular machines a circular pattern of features, such as a ring of holes or pockets, around a centre. Use it when the same feature repeats evenly around a circle.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.contour: Contour cuts around the outline of a 2D shape to the depth set in the operation. Use it to cut out a part's outside edge or an island's perimeter.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.engrave: Engrave cuts fine lines, such as text or a logo, with a small V or ball tool. Use it for marking a surface, not for removing material.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.face: Face removes the top layer of stock to bring the surface down to a set height. Use it to flatten the stock before other operations.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.pocket: Pocket clears the material inside a closed 2D shape to the set depth. Use it to cut recesses or slots that do not go through the part.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.slot: Slot cuts a straight or curved slot with the full tool width. Use it for keyways and grooves that run along the part.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.thread: Thread cuts an internal or external thread with a thread mill or tap. Use it when the part needs a machined thread of a set pitch.
ar.help.manufacture.2d.trace: Trace follows a single line or curve with a small tool. Use it to cut along a drawn path, such as a fine detail or a scribed line.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.adaptive: 3D Adaptive clears a 3D model's volume with a steady tool load in light passes. Use it to rough a 3D shape before a finishing pass.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.contour: 3D Contour follows the surface of a model in level steps, from top to bottom. Use it for steep and medium slopes that a finish pass should follow closely.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.flat: Flat machines the flat areas of a model with horizontal passes. Use it to finish level surfaces where the tool should stay parallel to the top.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.parallel: 3D Parallel makes evenly spaced passes across a model's surface. Use it for an even finish on gently sloped areas.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.scallop: Scallop keeps the scallop height between passes constant over a curved surface. Use it for a uniform finish on curved shapes, such as a moulded surface.
ar.help.manufacture.3d.steep: Steep finishes the steep parts of a model with contour passes and leaves the flat areas to other operations. Use it to finish walls and slopes.
ar.help.manufacture.additive.from_gcode: From G-code loads an existing G-code program as the toolpath for an additive build. Use it when the toolpath was made in another program.
ar.help.manufacture.additive.simulate: Simulate plays back the additive toolpath to check the build before it runs. Use it to find collisions and bad moves before printing.
ar.help.manufacture.additive.toolpath: Additive generates a toolpath for layer-by-layer deposition of a model. Use it to prepare a part for an additive machine.
ar.help.manufacture.drill: Drill makes holes at chosen points, to a set depth, with peck and retract. Use it for through holes, blind holes and tapping holes.
ar.help.manufacture.fabrication.nest: Nest arranges flat parts on a sheet to use as little material as possible. Use it before cutting several parts from one sheet.
ar.help.manufacture.fabrication.profile: 2D Profile cuts the outline of a flat part with a laser, waterjet or plasma head. Use it to cut sheet or plate parts out of the stock.
ar.help.manufacture.hole_recognition: Hole Recognition finds the holes in a model and lists them for drilling. Use it to get drilling operations without picking each hole by hand.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.align: Align sets the work coordinate system by matching measured points to the model. Use it when the part is clamped at an unknown position.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.geometry: Probe Geom measures a feature, such as a face, hole or boss, with a touch probe. Use it to check the position or size of a feature on the machine.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.manual: Manual lets you probe points by hand with the machine's probe. Use it for features that the automatic probing routines do not cover.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.record: Record saves the measured values of a setup for the inspection report. Use it after probing so the results stay with the part.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.surface: Surface probes a surface at a grid of points to check its shape. Use it to compare a machined surface with the model.
ar.help.manufacture.inspection.wcs: Probe WCS sets the work coordinate origin by probing the part's edges or corners. Use it when the part's origin must match the machine's zero.
ar.help.manufacture.manage.machine_library: Machines opens the machine library, where you choose or define the machine tool. Use it to set which machine the program is written for.
ar.help.manufacture.manage.post_library: Posts opens the post-processor library for the machine's G-code dialect. Use it to choose or add the post that writes the program.
ar.help.manufacture.manage.template_library: Templates opens the library of saved setups and operations. Use it to reuse machining you have already set up.
ar.help.manufacture.modify.delete_passes: Delete Passes removes selected cutting passes from an operation. Use it to drop passes you do not want in the toolpath.
ar.help.manufacture.modify.leads_links: Leads and Links set how the tool enters and leaves a cut and how it joins passes. Use them to avoid marks where the tool starts and stops.
ar.help.manufacture.modify.move_entry: Move Entry moves the start point of a toolpath. Use it to change where the tool begins its cut.
ar.help.manufacture.modify.replace_tool: Replace Tool swaps the tool of an operation and keeps its strategy. Use it to try a different cutter without rebuilding the operation.
ar.help.manufacture.modify.trim: Trim cuts back a toolpath at a boundary. Use it to stop a cut short of a feature without changing the operation.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.adv_swarf: Advanced Swarf cuts a wall with the side of a tapered tool across several axes. Use it for steep walls where plain Swarf needs more control.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.contour: MA Contour follows a surface with the tool tilted across several axes. Use it for complex surfaces that need the tool held at an angle.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.finish: MA Finish is a finishing pass with the tool tilted across several axes. Use it for the final surface of a complex shape.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.rotary: Rotary wraps a toolpath around a rotary axis to cut features on a cylinder. Use it for features on the outside of a round part.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.rough: MA Rough removes bulk material with the tool tilted across several axes. Use it to rough complex shapes before finishing.
ar.help.manufacture.multiaxis.swarf: Swarf cuts a wall with the side of the tool across several axes. Use it for walls that the tool's side can cut cleanly.
ar.help.manufacture.part_handling.bar_pull: Bar Pull feeds bar stock through the spindle for a turned part. Use it when the part is made from bar stock.
ar.help.manufacture.part_handling.grab: Grab takes the finished part from the chuck with the sub-spindle. Use it to move a turned part to the back side for more operations.
ar.help.manufacture.part_handling.return: Return puts the part back in the chuck after back-side work. Use it when the part must be turned or machined again.
ar.help.manufacture.part_handling.tool_call: Tool Call moves the turret or tool station to a chosen tool. Use it to bring the right tool into position before a cut.
ar.help.manufacture.post.process: Post writes the G-code program for the setup from its toolpaths. Use it once the toolpaths are done and the machine needs the program.
ar.help.manufacture.post.sheet: Setup Sheet writes a document listing the setup's tools, stock and origin for the operator. Use it to hand the setup to the machinist.
ar.help.manufacture.post.time: Cycle Time estimates how long the program will take to machine. Use it to compare strategies or quote a job.
ar.help.manufacture.setup.new: New Setup adds a machining setup with its own work coordinate system and stock. Use it for each side or orientation the part is machined from.
ar.help.manufacture.tools.library: Tool Library opens the cutting tool library, where you choose or define tools. Use it to pick the cutters the operations will use.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.chamfer: Chamfer cuts an angled edge on the end or diameter of a turned part. Use it to break sharp corners on a lathe part.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.face: Face cuts the end of a turned part square and to length. Use it to clean up the end or set the part's length.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.groove: Groove cuts a narrow groove into a turned part, such as a relief or an O-ring seat. Use it where the tool must cut in radially.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.part: Part cuts the finished part off the bar. Use it as the last operation on a turned part, once it is finished.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.profile: Profile follows the outline of a turned part with a lathe tool. Use it for the outside shape of a turned part.
ar.help.manufacture.turning.thread: Thread cuts a thread on a turned part with a threading tool. Use it for an external or internal thread of a set pitch on a lathe.
